meta.title: 被辞退的离职原因怎么说？分三种情况
meta.title_en: How to Explain a Termination: Three Scenarios

scenes.context: 讲者提出被辞退要不要跟面试官坦白，是面试中最棘手的问题。
sentences: 被辞退这一块的离职原因解释，比较有代表性。
Explaining a termination is the most representative question of all.
有代表性：the most representative
首先要解决的是，被辞退要不要跟面试官坦白。
The first thing to figure out is whether to be upfront about being fired.
坦白：be upfront
这个问题非常棘手，分三种情况来看。
It's a tricky question, so let's break it into three scenarios.
棘手：tricky
paraphrase: 先定问题 → 再分情况
Frame the question first, then split it into cases.
坦白与否 → 取决于具体情形
Whether to be upfront depends on the situation.
scenes.speak: Explaining a termination is the most representative question of all. The first thing to figure out is whether to be upfront about being fired. It's a tricky question, so let's break it into three scenarios.

scenes.context: 讲者说明公司原因可直说，个人原因且有背调支持可换主动离职原因。
sentences: 公司结构性裁员或经济性裁员，与工作表现无关，可以实话实说。
If it was a structural or economic layoff, it has nothing to do with your performance—be honest.
结构性裁员：structural layoff
个人原因被辞退，主管愿配合背调，就不提被辞退的事。
If it was personal and your boss backs the check, skip the termination topic.
配合背调：back the check
选择一个恰当的主动辞职原因，比如个人发展或家庭因素。
Use a proper voluntary reason, like personal growth or family matters.
主动辞职原因：voluntary reason
paraphrase: 公司原因 → 无负担地直说
Company-caused layoffs are safe to admit.
背调支持 → 换成主动离职
With check support, reframe it as a voluntary move.
scenes.speak: If it was a structural or economic layoff, it has nothing to do with your performance—be honest. If it was personal and your boss backs the check, skip the termination topic. Use a proper voluntary reason, like personal growth or family matters.

scenes.context: 讲者说明主管不支持背调时，只能有选择地实话实说，弱化原因聚焦成长。
sentences: 原来的主管不支持你的背景调查，那只能实话实说。
If your former boss won't support the background check, you have to tell the truth.
背景调查：background check
尽量弱化被辞退的原因，把重点放在教训上。
Downplay the reason and put the focus on what you learned.
弱化：downplay
讲清楚弥补措施，比如去培训、去充电。
Explain the steps you took to make up, like training and upskilling.
弥补措施：steps to make up
paraphrase: 诚实是底线 → 叙事是策略
Honesty is the floor; framing is the strategy.
焦点 → 从被辞转到成长
Shift the spotlight from being fired to your growth.
scenes.speak: If your former boss won't support the background check, you have to tell the truth. Downplay the reason and put the focus on what you learned. Explain the steps you took to make up, like training and upskilling.

practice: It was a company-wide layoff, not about my performance.
I decided to leave for personal growth reasons.
That experience taught me a valuable lesson.
I've taken courses and improved a lot since then.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：The company cut me off.
✓ 地道说法：I was laid off in a company restructuring.
被裁用 laid off in a restructuring，更具体。
✕ 直译腔：I was dismissed because of personal reason.
✓ 地道说法：I left, and I can explain the reasons.
个人原因场景下避免被动词 dismissed。
✕ 直译腔：The manager does the endorsement.
✓ 地道说法：My manager was willing to vouch for me.
背书用 vouch for，而不是 endorsement。
✓ 地道说法：Be honest, but choose your words carefully.
有选择地说用 choose your words carefully。
shifts: 先判断责任方与背调支持度
把所有辞退细节都交代
有选择地说：弱化原因，聚焦成长
把被辞退当可解释、可成长的经历
footer_notes: ASR 校正：原文「被调查」按语境校正为「背调」，其余口语（如「很有代表性」「做背书」）按口播习惯保留。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
